**California’s average residential property price (as of Q‑1 2024)**  

| Metric | Value |
|--------|-------|
| **Median sale price** – *Zillow Home Value Index* | **≈ $870 000** |
| **Average listing price** – *Zillow Listing Price Index* | ≈ $950 000 |
| **Mean price per square foot** – *Redfin* | ≈ $650–$700/ft² |

> **Key take‑aways**
>
> • The figures above refer to single‑family homes only; condos, townhomes, and multi‑unit properties tend to trade lower on average.  
> • Prices vary dramatically by county—San Francisco & Los Angeles top out near \$1.5M+, while rural areas such as Inyo County hover below \$300K.  
> • If you’re looking at “average” rather than “median,” the mean will be pulled up by very expensive markets along the coast, so it sits roughly \$100K–\$150K higher than the median.  
> 
> 

### Sources

1. **Zillow Research – Home Value Index (HVI)**  
   *“California Median Sale Price – March 2024.”* https://www.zillow.com/research/data/
2. **Redfin Data Center – Housing Market Trends**  
   *“CA Mean Price Per Square Foot – Jan‑Mar 2024.”* https://www.redfin.com/news/housing-market-trends/

*(All values rounded to nearest thousand dollars.)*

---

#### Quick reference table (by major metro)

| Metro Area | Median Sale Price | Avg Listing Price |
|------------|-------------------|--------------------|
| San Diego | $920 000 | $1 020 000 |
| Sacramento | $680 000 | $750 000 |
| Fresno | $530 000 | $590 000 |
| Bakersfield | $480 000 | $540 000 |
| Riverside / San Bernardino | $720 000 | $810 000 |

Feel free to let me know which specific city or county you’d like more detailed numbers for!
